field_mappings.transformation: Parse the whole abn cell as an Australian Business Number with the typed ABN parser (require_label false), stripping spaces and separators; keep only 11-digit values that pass the ABN checksum and reject 8-digit and 9-digit values.

unmapped_fields.reason: No original documentation defines contractor_name as the registered or legal name of the contracting entity, so entity.legal_name is unsupported; the field may hold trading-name text such as 't/a' clauses.
Contract description text is not a business identifier, name, address, or other canonical entity field.
Confidentiality flag describes the contract record, not a supported canonical entity or address field.
Contract monetary amount is not a supported canonical entity field.
Contract number is a contract identifier, not an ABN or ACN for the business.
Contract title is a contract description, not a registered legal name.
Directorate or public authority ownership names the government purchaser, not the contracting business subject.
Execution date is a contract date and not a supported observation time or whole-observation validity date.
Exemption flag concerns procurement threshold rules, not a supported canonical entity field.
Expiry date is a contract lifetime value and does not establish whole-observation validity.
GST treatment is a tax-status value about the contract amount, not an entity status or industry code.
Infrastructure or goods/services category describes the procurement, not a supported canonical entity field.
Internal matrix number is an internal reference, not an ABN, ACN, or other canonical identifier.
Panel contract flag describes the procurement arrangement, not a supported canonical entity field.
Panel contract number is a contract identifier, not an ABN or ACN.
Panel total amount is a monetary value and not a supported canonical entity field.
Previous department or agency names a government body and is not the contracting business subject's canonical field.
Procurement methodology describes how the contract was procured, not a supported canonical entity field.
Procurement type describes the contract category and is not the entity_type enum for the business.
SME flag is a procurement classification and not a supported canonical entity_type or status value.
Social procurement flag describes the procurement, not a supported canonical entity field.
Source row identifier is a dataset row key and not a business identifier.
Tender number is a procurement reference and not an ABN, ACN, or canonical entity identifier.
UNSPSC classification is not the ANZSIC industry_code defined by the ontology, so no crosswalk is supported.
Pre-qualification flag describes the procurement process, not a supported canonical entity field.
